verdict.rationale: SerpApi ships an official MCP server (github.com/serpapi/serpapi-mcp, plus a hosted endpoint at mcp.serpapi.com/mcp with Bearer auth) that lets any MCP-compatible agent such as Claude, ChatGPT or Cursor use it directly as a web-search tool. That covers the core 'ready-made agent tool' need. LLM-optimized markdown output (`output=md`, roughly half the tokens) helps agents consume the results, and a community complaint about the MCP server's API-key handling confirms people use it hands-on. missing for 10: documented function-calling/tool schemas outside MCP (no OpenAPI spec found, every candidate path returned 404), named agent-framework integrations (e.g., LangChain/LlamaIndex tool wrappers), and independent corroboration of how well the MCP tool works.
